summary: Public projects created on 21 April 2025: 3 repos and 1 dataset.
intro: Documentation repositories cover news monitoring dashboards for Israeli and Middle East coverage and system prompts for rewriting text in Shakespearean English. A prompt collection and reference dataset hold speech-to-text transformation prompts and what may be the largest set of Shakespearean rewriting prompts.
